title: Color Order · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Color Order · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Arrange three colored papers in a row and cover them after a brief look. The lead names the colors in order. The colors are named in their original order. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Three different colored papers and a cloth; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Color Order, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The colors are named in their original order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The colors are named in their original order.

game.materials: Three different colored papers and a cloth; a timer
